name: Raffle
description: Rows of raffle tickets end to end, each ticket and its stub in one color, round notches at the joins, a perforated tear line, and a star on every ticket.

code.style: --rule: ( --s: @once(@r(0, 100)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: $(floor((abs(sin(floor((@x - 1) / 2) * 12.9898 + @y * 78.233 + s) * 43758.5453) % 1) * 5)); --b: $(1 + floor((abs(sin(floor((@x - 1) / 2) * 39.346 + @y * 11.135 + s) * 24634.6345) % 1) * 4)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at @match(x % 2 == 1, 0%, 100%) 50%, transparent 11%, #000 11%), radial-gradient(circle at 7% 50%, transparent @match(x % 2 == 1, 0%, 2.4%), #000 @match(x % 2 == 1, 0%, 2.4%)) 0 0 / 100% 9.09%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at @match(x % 2 == 1, 0%, 100%) 50%, transparent 11%, #000 11%), radial-gradient(circle at 7% 50%, transparent @match(x % 2 == 1, 0%, 2.4%), #000 @match(x % 2 == 1, 0%, 2.4%)) 0 0 / 100% 9.09%; -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 17%; bottom: 17%; background: @match($(a) == 0, @p(var(--color1)), $(a) == 1, @p(var(--color2)), $(a) == 2, @p(var(--color3)), $(a) == 3, @p(var(--color4)), @p(var(--color5))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @match(x % 2 == 1, 30%, 40%); top: @match(x % 2 == 1, 28%, 40%); width: @match(x % 2 == 1, 44%, 20%); height: @match(x % 2 == 1, 44%, 20%); background: @match($((a + b) % 5) == 0, @p(var(--color1)), $((a + b) % 5) == 1, @p(var(--color2)), $((a + b) % 5) == 2, @p(var(--color3)), $((a + b) % 5) == 3, @p(var(--color4)), @p(var(--color5))); -webkit-clip-path: @match(x % 2 == 1, @var(--star), circle(50% at 50% 50%)); clip-path: @match(x % 2 == 1, @var(--star), circle(50% at 50% 50%)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-24deg, 24deg)); transform: rotate(@r(-24deg, 24deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --star: @shape(star); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
